Once i uploaded it, the bot got endless loading.
I've tried to reopen the bot, reboot the device and so on, but it didn't work out.
Previously I saw only 2 situations:
1. When the CSV was not ok, the bot was not accepting it
2. When the CSV was fine it was just working.
Please advice on this.

And also, I saw that the Onihelper has the "bulk posting option". But it was kinda not clear how to use it.
As all my accounts are working in different time. We have like 6 accounts on each device, that are working for 4 rounds (30 mins each) during the day.
Could you please explain how to use this thing?
